name: Gitea
description: Self-hosted or Cloud. Lightweight, fast and low resource usage. Agents will check repositories out, branch and open pull requests there.

tools.name: gitea.read_repository
tools.description: Permission to read repository contents, if this connection grants it later.

tools.name: gitea.create_branch
tools.description: Permission to create a branch, if this connection grants it later.

tools.name: gitea.open_pull_request
tools.description: Permission to propose changes for review, if this connection grants it later.

tools.name: gitea.merge_pull_request
tools.description: Permission to integrate proposed changes without a review, if this connection grants it later.
